summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests oral Restorative Microbiota Therapy (RMT) capsules or placebo, given with durvalumab and chemotherapy, in people with untreated advanced or metastatic lung adenocarcinoma. RMT or placebo capsules are taken weekly for 16 doses, durvalumab 1500 mg IV is given every 4 weeks until progression or for up to two years, and cisplatin or carboplatin with pemetrexed is given every 3 weeks for 4 cycles. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa cápsulas orales de terapia restauradora de microbiota (RMT) o placebo, combinadas con durvalumab y quimioterapia, en personas con adenocarcinoma de pulmón avanzado o metastásico que no han recibido tratamiento. Las cápsulas de RMT o placebo se toman una vez por semana durante 16 dosis; durvalumab 1500 mg por vía intravenosa se administra cada 4 semanas hasta la progresión o por un máximo de dos años, y cisplatino o carboplatino con pemetrexed se administra cada 3 semanas durante 4 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with untreated advanced or metastatic lung adenocarcinoma, stage IIIB/C or IV.
No EGFR sensitizing mutation and no ALK or ROS1 translocation.
Archived unstained tumor tissue available, with known PD-L1 TC status assayed by Ventana SP263.
not_for: Squamous, large cell, NSCLC NOS, or mixed tumor histology.
Untreated brain metastasis or active leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
Prior anti-PD-1, PD-L1, or durvalumab treatment, except certain adjuvant therapy more than six months ago.
Daily probiotic use within 4 weeks before the first dose.
Active or prior autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment within 2 years, or interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis needing steroids.
